A degree in fundraising/development management or a professional fundraising certification (e.g., CFRE) is an added advantage. content_sections.heading: TISS Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 2 vacancies are available – 1 for Manager – Resource Mobilization [Fund Raiser (Senior)] and 1 for Assistant Manager – Resource Mobilization [Fund Raiser (Junior)].

content_sections.heading: TISS Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Manager – Resource Mobilization [Fund Raiser (Senior)]: Master's degree in Management, Social Work, Development Studies, Economics, Media, Communications, or a related field. A degree in fundraising/development management or a professional fundraising certification (e.g., CFRE) is an added advantage. Minimum 8-10 years of relevant experience in fundraising, resource mobilization, or development, preferably in the education, non-profit, or institutional sector. Assistant Manager – Resource Mobilization [Fund Raiser (Junior)]: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Management, Social Work, Media, Communications, Development Studies, or a related field. 1-3 years of experience in fundraising, marketing, communications, or the development/non-profit sector. Freshers with strong relevant internships may be considered.

content_sections.text: All Posts: Maximum Age Limit is 50 years.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted online on or before 05-08-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of TISS to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for TISS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the TISS Manager and Assistant Manager posts is 05 August 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before the deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies released by TISS?
faq.answer: Tata Institute of Social Sciences has released a total of 2 vacancies for the posts of Manager – Resource Mobilization [Fund Raiser (Senior)] and Assistant Manager – Resource Mobilization [Fund Raiser (Junior)].

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the TISS posts?
faq.answer: For the Manager post, a Master's degree is required, while for the Assistant Manager post, a Bachelor's or Master's degree in relevant fields is necessary. Specific details are provided in the eligibility criteria section.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for TISS recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the posts announced under this TISS recruitment is 50 years as of 30 June 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the TISS Manager and Assistant Manager posts?
faq.answer: The salary for the Manager – Fund Raiser (Senior) post is Rs. 150000/- per month, and for the Assistant Manager – Fund Raiser (Junior) post, it is Rs. 50000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for the TISS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Interested and eligible candidates can apply online through the official TISS website or the direct application link provided in the Important Links section before the last date.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee for TISS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee varies by category. General/OBC candidates need to pay Rs. 500/-, SC/ST candidates need to pay Rs. 125/-, and Women candidates are exempted from paying any fee.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for these TISS positions?
faq.answer: The selection process for the TISS recruitment involves a Personal Interaction followed by Document Verification. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their performance in these stages.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any experience required for the TISS posts?
faq.answer: Yes, the Manager post requires 8-10 years of relevant experience, while the Assistant Manager post requires 1-3 years of experience. Freshers with relevant internships may be considered for the Assistant Manager role.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official TISS Recruitment 2026 notification?
faq.answer: The official TISS Recruitment 2026 notification PDF can be downloaded from the Important Links section of this article. It is recommended to read the notification thoroughly before applying.
